description: Source code for flash memory driver functions in an AUTOSAR platform, including programming, erasing, status checking, and reading flash memory, with specific hardware register manipulations.

methods.name: FSL_FlashProgramStart
methods.description: Programs a page of flash memory, handling data buffering and hardware register interactions.

methods.name: FSL_FlashEraseStart
methods.description: Initiates a flash memory erase operation on specified blocks.

methods.name: FSL_FlashCheckStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of ongoing flash operations, including completion and error states.

methods.name: FSL_FlashRead8
methods.description: Reads a byte from flash memory at a specified address.

methods.name: FSL_FlashRead64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit double word from flash memory at a specified address.

methods.name: FSL_FlashRead
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory into a buffer, with suspend/resume handling.

methods.name: FSL_FlashEraseAbort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing flash erase operation.

methods.name: FSL_FlashResume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended flash programming or erasing operation.

methods.name: FSL_FlashSuspend
methods.description: Suspends an ongoing flash programming or erasing operation.

methods.name: EER_exception_handler
methods.description: Handles ECC error exceptions, setting error flags accordingly.
